note: Pre-registered after H1 passed and before any Phase 2 backtest ran. Never edit after a run; supersede with addendum_2.
question: Does giving picks from the best-placed sector held twice the money of the other picks bought the same week improve the strategies, after tax, without deeper falls?

lever.setting: categories.broad.run_broad_backtest(top_sector_weight=2.0): a buy week's money is shared in proportion to 2 for picks whose category is first in that week's held list and 1 for the rest (engine.run_backtest buy_weights, shifted by signal_delay; position caps still apply)
lever.why_one_value: one trial: no choosing among settings on the same data

strategies_note: all eleven saved Broad groups, each sleeve re-run with its saved config_full; a group's curve is its sleeves blended at equal capital reset each April (tranches.blend_reset). Trio did not show the H1 pattern and is included anyway
money: after tax (tax on, slab 30%), Rs 5 lakh per group split equally across its sleeves; pre-tax reported too

windows.development: 2017-01-01 to 2022-12-30: the runs end on 2022-12-30; every pass rule is judged here
windows.confirmation: 2023-01-06 to 2026-10-16: read once, only if development passes, from a run over the whole span sliced to this window
windows.caveat: all eleven groups were chosen on 2017-2026 results; H1 was decided on 2017-2022 trades of nine of them

metrics.cagr: of the group's weekly curve in the window
metrics.max_drawdown: deepest peak-to-trough fall of that curve

pass_rule_development.a_return: median over the 11 of (lever CAGR - baseline CAGR) >= +0.005 AND lever CAGR not lower in at least 7 of 11
pass_rule_development.b_risk: lever max drawdown no more than 2 percentage points deeper than baseline's in at least 9 of 11 AND median Ulcer change <= +0.01

confirmation_rule: median CAGR change >= 0 AND max drawdown no more than 2 points deeper in at least 8 of 11, on 2023-01-06 to 2026-10-16

verdict.adopt_candidate: passes development and confirmation: a candidate setting for the owner to decide on (nothing in the live signal changes by itself)
verdict.kill: fails development, or passes it and fails confirmation

report_only: the share of buy-week money that went to top-sector picks
will_not_run: rebalancing existing holdings to the weights
